Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi there !

Here comes today's question :

My vampire A has an untapped Helicopter. He performs an action, which
is not successful.
1/ My second minion B performs an action, which is successful. Can
Vampire A tap his Helicopter to untap?
2/ My prey's minion performs a successful action. Can Vampire A tap
his Helicopter to untap ?

I'm sure there are other stupid questions that can raise from the
ground, but those two were the first I could find today.

Helicopter [Third:U/PTr]
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 3 pool
Vehicle.
When a minion equips with the Helicopter, tap it. After resolving a
successful action, this minion may tap the Helicopter to untap. A
minion may have only one vehicle.
